title: 檜尾口訣
source_attribution: 善通寺宝物館 国文学研究資料館
transcription_method: Root visual inspection of the complete original JPEG and exact plain crops; no model completion of uncertain glyphs. Whitespace, reading marks and layout omitted, virtual mansion name 虛 normalized to 虚 in mansion fields only. Literal strings retain 虛.

observations.normalized_transcription: 勘宿曜經取閏月之宿及小月之闕日分宿法依口説

observations.location: canvas29 right page, next calendar column
observations.normalized_transcription: 其正月直宿即亦重直閏月

observations.location: canvas29 right page, last calendar column
observations.normalized_transcription: 其十二月一日直宿是虛宿

observations.location: canvas29 right final calendar column to left first column
canvas29 left page, first body column from right
observations.normalized_transcription: 乃至三十日直宿是室宿

observations.location: canvas29 left page, second and third body columns from right
observations.normalized_transcription: 先月是正十二月閏月是傍十二月也故傍月

observations.location: canvas29 left page, fourth and fifth body columns from right
observations.normalized_transcription: 假令正月小闕第三十日雖無其第三十日而彼日分直宿猶有故

observations.location: canvas29 left page, sixth body column from right
observations.normalized_transcription: 上者正月闕日之分宿直也
observations.scope: Only the clear continuation; no supplied character between 半 and 上.

observations.location: canvas29 left page, sixth and seventh body columns from right
observations.scope: Only the clear continuation; no normalization of the preceding 己/已 form.

observations.location: canvas29 left page, eighth body column from right
observations.normalized_transcription: 次月初一日直宿無改代也

scope: Distinct catalogue object from Kyoto RB00017868 and Zentsuji109-5; selected testimony alongside existing readings, not a new operative calendar. Does not resolve Kyoto uncertain glyphs, Taisho witness identity, historical dawn or half-clock mapping, or intercalary/short-month precedence.
